purpose: Query-only product replay, not a solver/scout/embedding evaluation.
candidate_source_state: Built and tested before committing the implementation as candidate_source_commit; exact executable SHA-256 pins this run.

timing.order: Full request list alternates forward/reverse per round.
timing.measurement: Parent perf_counter wall time around each complete CLI process; includes startup, SQLite opening, query and serialization; excludes solver interpretation.

constraints: No index, embed, scout, solver, provider or model calls.
Original and copied DB SHA-256 unchanged after all requests.
Explicit DB paths and config-free root; text queries are exhaustive or lexical-only.
Documentation selected source files do not exist under replay root; source_mismatch is expected existing source verification, not a scope failure.

historical_two_calls.guarded_counterfactual_request_change: Explicit match_mode:any without allow_broad; unchanged requests instead use default AND.
